messages.subject: VACUUM RATE IN SUGAR CANE
parts:
hello to you, please I have a new concern
I'm looking for voids in a young sugar cane plot.
I was able to materialize the first line and I already have a result. But my worries are that:
1; is it possible to materialize several lines at the same time in order to have and have a result of the distances between each materialized line?

2. Is it possible to generate these lines on qgis or arcgis in order to have a SHP data?

THANK YOU

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: VACUUM RATE IN SUGAR CANE
parts:
Hi Bamba, thank you for asking. 

 

The software does not make the lines by itself yet (I will work on that soon). For now, you should draw each line where the software needs to evaluate distance between plants. You can use the parameter "ndraw" to inform the number of lines you want to evaluate (remember to press ESC after each drawing). For example, 4 lines you should to use ndraw = 4. (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P11)

 

Dist <- fieldDraw(mosaic,ndraw = 4)

 

It is possible import lines from qgis and arcgis to the R, however it will be a shapefile. This function does not use external shapefiles to extract information yet. Thanks for this suggestion...!

 

library(rgdal)

ShapeFile <- readOGR("Other_Software_ShapeFile.shp")

 

Let me know if it worked for you. As soon as I make new changes in this function, I will let you know.

 

All the best,

Filipe
